name: card
description: A titled surface that is one thing: title, one supporting line, and either a whole-card tap or one action — never both.
avoidWhen: Do not use as a generic Box with elevation. Do not make it clickable and give it a button.

ux.behaviour: Title and supporting line merge for TalkBack
ux.why: A card is one thought, not six nodes

ux.behaviour: Either the whole card is the tap or one AppButton sits under the copy — never both
ux.why: Two actions on one card is a guess

ux.behaviour: A clickable card scales while pressed and fires a click haptic

aiHints: Pick the clickable overload or the action overload, not both
Do not nest interactive content inside a clickable card
